anchors.label: Left chest (medals)
anchors.note: No. 2 (mess dress), Guidelines for uniform.pdf (project owner) pp.5-6: miniature medals on the left lower lapel, in the order picked. Drawn as miniatures: scale 0.495 (about 16 px visible width each, 1 px gap), hanging from y 190, centred on x 472 so the pins, the SAF badges and the medals share one vertical line. The PDF puts the top edge 6 cm below the lowest point of the upper lapel (y 142); the lower lapel narrows toward the waist, so it hangs from y 190 to keep every medal inside it. A row wider than 160 mm (scaled) overlaps its medals so it fits; that limit comes from picture D-3 of the SAF No.1 Dress PDF only. Redrawn No. 2 art; position and scale chosen by eye with the project owner (draft F), not calibrated (pxPerMm is an assumption).

anchors.label: Left chest, above pocket
anchors.note: No. 2, Guidelines for uniform.pdf (project owner) pp.5-6: maximum 3 SAF badges in total, centred above the miniature medals on the left lower lapel (the same centre line as the medals, x 472), just below the lowest point of the upper lapel. Bottom edge about 2 px above the top of the medals (y 188 when no medals are worn: the medals hang from a fixed top). Exceptional skills first. 1 or 2 badges are one row; 3 are a pyramid (first badge alone on top). Scale 0.603 (about 22 px visible width), 2 px between boxes, rows overlap by 10.5 px of padding (about 3 px of the art overlap, as in the approved draft). minY 75 is the lowest the top may reach (the shoulder board is about y 70), checked by a test. Sizes chosen by eye, not from the regulations.

anchors.label: Right chest (foreign badges)
anchors.note: SAF No.1 Dress PDF (March 2024): maximum 3, centred, bottom edge 1 cm above the top edge of the right pocket flap or in line with the SAF badges (if worn), whichever is higher. pxPerMm is not calibrated. This drawing has no pocket flaps, so the spot is where number-1 puts it (the 6 cm and 1 cm distances are measured from where its flap would be). Same placement as number-1 (project owner). Foreign badges: the PDF puts them centred on the right upper lapel with their centre 3 cm below the lapel notch (about x 290, y 133); we have no foreign badge art yet, so this spot is unchanged from number-1.

anchors.label: Right side
anchors.note: Source says 'right side of the uniform'. Exact spot unknown. Same placement as number-1 (project owner).

anchors.label: Left sleeve (tabs)
anchors.note: Maximum of two tabs. SAF No.1 Dress PDF (March 2024) p.15: centred on the shoulder board, 1 cm below the left shoulder seam, the second tab immediately before the first. Position is a guess (scale not calibrated). Same placement as number-1 (project owner).

anchors.label: Left upper lapel (IPPT, marksmanship)
anchors.note: No. 2, Guidelines for uniform.pdf (project owner) pp.5-6: IPPT and marksmanship are miniature pins on the left upper lapel (the viewer's right), not on the sleeve. Not more than two proficiency badges. Stacked one above the other, IPPT on top (the marksmanship-below-IPPT rule of the sleeve), centred on x 472 and y about 109 in the middle of the upper lapel, 2 px between the boxes. IPPT about 14 px and marksmanship about 16 px visible width (item scales 0.528 and 0.404). Flat art, not the sleeve's perspective sprites. Chosen by eye with the project owner (draft F), not calibrated.

anchors.label: Right upper lapel (arms badge)
anchors.note: No. 2, Guidelines for uniform.pdf (project owner) pp.5-6: the arms (branch) badge is worn on the right upper lapel (the viewer's left), one badge, no copy on the other lapel. A silver pin on No. 2 (art variant arms-silver, see badges.json). Centred on the upper lapel panel at about (262, 110), upright, about 20 px visible width for the narrowest pin (infantry) and 20 to 23 px for the others (scale 1.323, all pins are drawn the same height). Chosen by eye with the project owner (draft F), not calibrated.

anchors.label: Right sleeve (foreign tabs)
anchors.note: Maximum of two tabs, worn the same way as on the left sleeve (SAF No.1 Dress PDF (March 2024) p.15). Position is a guess (scale not calibrated). Same placement as number-1 (project owner).

anchors.label: Right sleeve (foreign badges)
anchors.note: Maximum of two badges, worn the same way as on the left sleeve (SAF No.1 Dress PDF (March 2024) p.15). Position is a guess (scale not calibrated). Same placement as number-1 (project owner).

anchors.label: Shoulders
anchors.note: One board on each shoulder, button at the collar end. Drawn from number-1's perspective sprites (mountedFrom), because the shoulders and sleeves are in the same place; see docs/PERSPECTIVE.md in the badge-art-pipeline project.

anchors.label: Right sleeve (rank)
anchors.note: Lowest point of the chevron 24 cm from the shoulder seam, centre in line with the centre of the shoulder board (SAF No.1 Dress PDF, March 2024, p.8). Only the front half shows from the front. Position is a guess (scale not calibrated). Same placement as number-1 (project owner).
